authoring_method: 100 original semantic scenario/control pairs; data-only packaging, no scanner-driven acceptance filter.
independence: Separate from the original targeted regressions and authored without executing the scanner on any case. Same assistant authored code and corpus; this is not independent external validation.
review_status: author self-review complete; external independent labeling/review pending
population: synthetic skill/package behavior scenarios, not a representative sample of real installed skills
holdout_policy: 30 complete families, 30 malicious and 30 benign cases; do not score or tune against holdout before final acceptance. Author has seen the authored holdout; this is process separation, not access control.
